translations.literal: Daoguang year 26, bingwu cyclical year.
translations.idiomatic: Daoguang 26 (bingwu)

sentences.zh: 十二月庚午來京。四川總督。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day gengwu: summoned to the capital. Sichuan governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Summoned to the capital on gengwu of the twelfth month as Sichuan governor-general.

sentences.zh: 八月乙亥降。雲貴總督。署。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day yihai: demoted. Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general. Acting appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Demoted on yihai of the eighth month while holding Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general; acting appointment.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊申調。署漕運總督。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day wushen: reassigned. Acting grain-transport governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Reassigned on wushen of the twelfth month as acting grain-transport governor-general.

sentences.zh: 道光二十七年丁未

translations.literal: Daoguang year 27, dingwei cyclical year.
translations.idiomatic: Daoguang 27 (dingwei)

sentences.zh: 正月乙酉覲。署。三月丁未遷。兩江總督。

translations.literal: First month, day yiyou: imperial audience. Acting appointment. Third month, day dingwei: transferred. Liangjiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Granted imperial audience on yiyou of the first month; acting appointment. Transferred on dingwei of the third month to Liangjiang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 八月甲子赴肅州督剿。署。九月辛巳回陝甘總督。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiazi: went to Suzhou to supervise suppression operations. Acting appointment. Ninth month, day xinsi: returned to Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi of the eighth month went to Suzhou to supervise suppression operations; acting appointment. Returned to Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general on xinsi of the ninth month.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲戌來京。署兩廣總督。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiaxu: summoned to the capital. Acting Liangguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Summoned to the capital on jiaxu of the twelfth month as acting Liangguang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 三月乙未調。雲貴總督。署。

translations.literal: Third month, day yiwei: reassigned. Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general. Acting appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Reassigned on yiwei of the third month to Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general; acting appointment.

sentences.zh: 道光二十八年戊申

translations.literal: Daoguang year 28, wushen cyclical year.
translations.idiomatic: Daoguang 28 (wushen)

sentences.zh: 六月丙午留京。授兩廣總督。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day bingwu: remained at the capital. Appointed Liangguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Remained at the capital on bingwu of the sixth month and was appointed Liangguang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 九月甲戌病免。江南河道總督。署。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiaxu: excused from office due to illness. Jiangnan river-works governor-general. Acting appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Excused from office on jiaxu of the ninth month for illness as Jiangnan River Works Governor-General; acting appointment.

sentences.zh: 道光二十九年己酉

translations.literal: Daoguang year 29, jiyou cyclical year.
translations.idiomatic: Daoguang 29 (jiyou)

sentences.zh: 四月壬寅病免。兩江總督。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day renyin: excused from office due to illness. Liangjiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Excused from office on renyin of the fourth month for illness as Liangjiang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 九月甲辰病免。署陝甘總督。九月己酉實授。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiachen: excused from office due to illness. Acting Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general. Ninth month, day jiyou: confirmed in formal appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Excused from office on jiachen of the ninth month for illness as acting Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general. Received formal appointment on jiyou of the ninth month.

sentences.zh: 九月甲辰調。署。己酉四川總督。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiachen: reassigned. Acting appointment. Day jiyou: Sichuan governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Reassigned on jiachen of the ninth month; acting appointment. On jiyou became Sichuan governor-general.

sentences.zh: 七月己未病免。雲貴總督。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day jiwei: excused from office due to illness. Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Excused from office on jiwei of the seventh month for illness as Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general.

sentences.zh: 閏四月辛未卒。河東河道總督。署。

translations.literal: Intercalary fourth month, day xinwei: died. Hedong river-works governor-general. Acting appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Died on xinwei of the intercalary fourth month while serving as Hedong River Works Governor-General; acting appointment.

sentences.zh: 道光三十年庚戌

translations.literal: Daoguang year 30, gengxu cyclical year.
translations.idiomatic: Daoguang 30 (gengxu)

sentences.zh: 十一月丙午病卸。閩浙總督。署。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingwu: relieved due to illness. Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general. Acting appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Relieved on bingwu of the eleventh month due to illness as Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general; acting appointment.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙午調。湖廣總督。署。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingwu: reassigned. Huguang governor-general. Acting appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Reassigned on bingwu of the eleventh month to Huguang governor-general; acting appointment.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙午調。雲貴總督。十二月壬申署。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingwu: reassigned. Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general. Twelfth month, day renshen: acting appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Reassigned on bingwu of the eleventh month to Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general. Acting appointment on renshen of the twelfth month.
